notes.title: Fractalis 0.8.1 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630920/d516f7b61bff59754a866e4413b41e8e71bfaf5b.png[/img]
Changed: Fixed various bugs in the procedural generation that would cause the game to not be completable in some cases.  The time that the world generation takes should also be faster and more consistent in many cases.  Also the placement of trap doors should be more evenly spaced.

notes.title: Fractalis 0.8.0 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630920/6503b4b08a7dfe6d24c8765d134273460df51cdb.png[/img]
Change Log

Added: I added two new potions to the game.  The first potion is called a potion of might.  This potion will give you an attack buff for a limited time.  The second potion is called a potion of fortitude. This potion will give you a defense buff for a limited time.

Changed: Fixed various typos in the game.
Changed: Fixed a bug where you would get stuck in the dark work after killing a boss.
Changed: The player will now stop if an enemy starts following the player.
Changed: Enemies will now show a yellow exclamation mark when they start following the player or range attack the player.
Changed: Shop slots will now show up yellow when you try to drag an item that the shop won’t accept.

notes.title: Fractalis 0.7.19 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630920/926cba82b4c4cc9687fdad167b04265c363fe9fe.png[/img]
Change Log

Added: I implemented item stacking/unstacking for items with the same type and different stats. 
When you stack items with different stats a Cyan S will show up on the item.  You can also unstack these items by ctrl clicking them.

Changed: Fixed a few bugs with the previous item stacking.
Changed: Fixed various typos in the game.

notes.title: Fractalis 0.7.18 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630920/28f9bfeaafc5d40f764b1a4bd358d1cfa96ea96b.png[/img]
Change Log

Added: I implemented item stacking/unstacking for items with the same type and the exact same stats.  Right now the stacking only works with coins, and pre-stacked items.  But in the future I would like to add item stacking for items of the same type but with different stats. (I will possibly add this feature in the next update if I can get it working quickly enough) 

To stack items you just drag an item on top of one another, and to un-stack it you ctrl left click to bring up an un-stack menu.

Changed:  Fixed bug on mac where inventory items would show up as just boxes.
Changed:  I changed the prices of items/coins to take in account the amount in a stack.

Change Log

Added: Added messages when you try to use a ranged weapon when you are out of range or not in sight of an enemy.

notes.title: Fractalis 0.7.16 Update

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630920/c7aca310fb60226d77e85d7316fa4ae656a50763.png[/img]

notes.title: Fractalis 0.7.11 Demo Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35630920/6982994a9327e1a1c7ccbdd43e6167871a90e035.png[/img]

Recently, I have been getting feedback that the game is to difficult for a lot of people. So I decided to change the balancing of the game a little bit. 

Now the game has 4 difficulty levels instead of 3.  The ‘hard’ level will stay the same. But the old ‘medium’ level has now been changed to ‘difficult’.  And the old ‘easy’ level has been changed to ‘medium’.  And now there is a new ‘easy’ level that should be easier then the old one. 

So if you want to try the new easy level you can create a new world, on the title screen, and select easy.
Hopefully the game should be playable for most people, but if it still isn't more balancing might be needed in the future.

Breaking Change: 
In previously created worlds, some items will have wrong stat values, levels, and item values

These items include:
Staffs 
Animal projectiles
Poison Antidotes 
Knifes

Unfortunately, the only way to fix this is to delete the world, and recreate it with the same seed. But, buy doing this you will lose all your progress in that world.
